description: Source code for the TransactionTracing class in Android's surfaceflinger service, managing transaction trace data collection, buffering, and serialization.

classes.name: TransactionTracing
classes.description: Manages transaction tracing, including buffering, serialization, and thread management for surfaceflinger.

methods.name: TransactionTracing
methods.description: Constructor initializing the tracing system, starting the tracing thread.

methods.name: ~TransactionTracing
methods.description: Destructor stopping the tracing thread and writing data to file.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Serializes trace data and writes it to a specified file.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Adjusts the buffer size for trace data.

methods.name: createTraceFileProto
methods.description: Creates a proto object representing the trace file header.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs current trace state information into a string.

methods.name: addQueuedTransaction
methods.description: Adds a transaction to the queue for tracing.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main thread loop processing trace updates.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds trace entries based on committed updates and destroyed layers.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Ensures all trace data up to a specific vsync ID is processed.

methods.name: onLayerRemoved
methods.description: Marks a layer as removed for tracing.

methods.name: tryPushToTracingThread
methods.description: Attempts to transfer pending updates to the tracing thread.

methods.name: updateStartingStateLocked
methods.description: Updates internal state based on a removed trace entry.

methods.name: addStartingStateToProtoLocked
methods.description: Adds the starting state of layers and display info to the trace proto.
